Entry 01

How it started

Yes, I made you a whole journal. I had free time and too many feelings. No regrets. Warning: you're going to smile a lot while reading this. Not responsible for sore cheeks.

Okay, origin story time. The photos have opinions.

Tap each photo to reveal

Exhibit A: the smile
The very first thing I noticed. Still the best thing in the room.
Exhibit B: the vibe
Calm, curious and a little cheeky. Dangerous combination.

First thing I noticed about you? Your smile. Obviously. It works overtime.

Second thing? You were so real. Even when life was heavy, you were just genuine. No filter, no show. Good, honest talks. I remember thinking, okay, this one is rare.

Then the name. You introduced yourself as Stella and I was like, nice. Much later your Instagram spilled the real one: Royina. Sounded like a princess from some old story, so I promoted you. You're welcome.

Entry 03

Dr. Royina's clinic

True story. After my eye operation, my eyes were dry and annoying, and you suggested a drop. My actual doctor suggested the exact same one.

So I said, wait, are you a doctor? Be my personal doctor. You said yes, called me your favourite patient, and promised kisses and cuddles if I'm ever unwell.

I've been suspiciously unwell ever since. Medically speaking.

The last page

Happy birthday, Princess.

Dear Royina,

(Stella, Princess, babe, whatever you're answering to today.)

Okay, straight talk, because you'd call me out anyway:

I really like you. I love talking to you, I love your voice notes and your singing, and I do miss having a bit more of you in my everyday life. No pressure. Just the truth.

You're an amazing person: strong, warm, genuine, and a lot of fun. I'm really glad I got to know you.

And yes, I'd really love to meet you. Soon. Whenever life lines up.

I'd love to see you in a saree and mekhela sador and walk you through Mumbai. Berry pulao at Britannia & Co. first.

Warning: if you smile at me in person like you do in these photos, I'll lose all my words. And you know I have a lot of words.

Happy birthday, Princess Royina. Be adored today, and every day.

Your favourite patient,

Lalit
